response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced full-stack/web developer with strong credentials in JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and D language, but his profile does not align with this role's core requirement of deep, current C++ development expertise for industrial automation systems. His C++ experience is limited to a single role over a decade ago (2014-2015) and a bachelor's thesis project, with no evidence of STL mastery, multi-threading, message brokers, MQTT, IEC 62443 security standards, or industrial protocols central to this position.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, senior-level software engineering experience
Strong background in distributed systems, async I/O, and high-performance backend work (DLang, microservices)
Demonstrated mentoring, workshop facilitation, and technical communication skills
concerns: Minimal recent C++ experience (last significant use over 10 years ago)
No evidence of IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity experience
No mention of MQTT, REST-based IoT work, UML, or industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, etc.)

key_factors.factor: Strong general software engineering seniority and architecture experience
